**C.** Endurance training raises mitochondrial density and oxidative enzyme capacity, so the muscle can burn more fat and carbohydrate aerobically. The team note is wrong: endurance training doesn't mainly increase shortening speed, since maximal shortening velocity is determined largely by fibre type and myosin ATPase and is improved little by endurance work. Options A, B and D are the adaptations of sprint and strength training.

CONFIDENCE: 92
